title: Refund request
summary: A message claims a refund is waiting and asks for payment or account action.
scenario: The request uses a refund explanation to collect credentials, fees, or payment approval.
warning_signs: A fee is required before money can be returned
The requester asks for a code or remote access
safe_actions: Do not pay a refund fee or reveal secrets
Check order or account history using the official app or site you already use
Contact the merchant through known details
recovery_guidance: Secure any account information that was shared
Contact the payment provider and merchant promptly
reporting_guidance: Keep order, message, and payment records
prevention_tips: Refunds should be traceable in your existing account history
Do not let an incoming message choose the support route
false_positive_notes: A real merchant may issue a refund without asking for a password, PIN, or one-time code.
